lines: You might not sleep or eat well.
You might sleep or eat too much.
You might have stomachaches or headaches.
Breathe slowly and drink some water.
Take a walk and listen to your favorite music.
Talk about your worries with other people.
ko: 너는 잘 자거나 잘 먹지 못할 수도 있다.
너는 너무 많이 자거나 먹을 수도 있다.
너는 배가 아프거나 머리가 아플 수도 있다.
천천히 숨 쉬고 물을 좀 마셔라.
다른 사람들과 너의 걱정에 대해 이야기해라.
body.text: You might not sleep or eat well. You might sleep or eat too much. You might have stomachaches or headaches. Breathe slowly and drink some water. Take a walk and listen to your favorite music. Talk about your worries with other people.
